$comment: The ports of /1 cards to /2 (docs/plans/scenario-builder.md §7.3, piece B7). One row per port, added by that port's own pull request: v1 (the frozen /1 card's file, relative to this folder), v2 (the /2 card's file), presses (the press path: sim time t, the /1 button label or event, the /2 action id), untilS (the stop: sim seconds on the engine's clock), accepted (the flagged beats the owner signs as changed by design: at, what changed, the source of the proposed truth rule or 'no source: instructor-pressed'), and result (the twin run's words as ports.slow.test.ts last measured them in CI; the test fails when the run no longer reads so, and the builder shows these words). Empty until the first port.
